## Constraints

### Must

- Use the existing page grid and Sanity project images. Bundle explicitly requested

- Keep Register interest as the primary homepage CTA.

### Avoid

- Framer Motion, Three.js, Cloudinary and decorative nested cards.

## Decisions

- Feature Almond Suites immediately after the homepage hero on white. Overlay
  availability left, the selling line centered, and progress right on the desktop
  photograph; fade the overlay on hover. On mobile, keep only the selling line over
  the image, with concise copy and the CTA stacked to fit together in one viewport.
  Use a teal Register interest button linked to the existing project enquiry form.


- Reveal both homepage hero plates in paired tiles before the existing TDK
  entrance. Use masked per-letter rising entrances across other text, with a
  bounded stagger, and preserve the scroll narrative and reduced-motion behavior.

- Rebuild the footer around the supplied reference: a white four-column index, teal
  rectangular Register interest button with white text, image-filled TDK DESIGN & BUILD and an aligned full-width
  photo below. Bundle the user-provided Modular two-bedroom sunset photograph.
  Keep the white content and letter shapes scrolling normally. Start the room
  higher and move it more slowly, sharing one offset through the wordmark and
  photograph, with enough image overscan to cover the motion and a static reduced-motion view.
- Keep the homepage Contact intro and photograph in place. Replace its details and
  Write to us link with the shared ContactForm, wired to /api/contact. Use the shared
  button-label optical offset for centered filled button text.
- Finish the desktop Interlude with WE HOUSE left of the centered photograph and
  YOUR DREAM right, aligned to its centerline, and the original paragraph below.
  Remove the cyan wordmark. Open three progressively smaller concentric clear-glass
  panes inward, strictly in sequence, finishing by 78% of the image pullback.
  The first starts at the image edges; each inner pane starts at its parent's settled edges.
  Refract the actual image through narrow canvas-drawn rims with transparent centers
  and no frost. Preserve the existing mobile vertical beats and reduced-motion support.
- Keep the large footer wordmark visible immediately, without an entrance. Contact
  and residence forms validate inline, preserve details on delivery errors, prevent
  repeat submission while sending, and confirm after the studio email is accepted.
- Match the featured-project and footer filled CTAs to the rectangular site buttons:
  white text on teal, uppercase tracked labels, centered caps and dark hover states.
- Keep homepage project titles at their original clamp(1.9rem, 3.4vw, 4.2rem) size
  on one line, shrinking only to fit narrow screens. Difference-blend the white text
  across photographs; remove project numbering and the circular next button.
- Share smooth fill and drawn-edge focus animations across all enquiry forms.
  TDKSelect provides a rectangular branded list, keyboard navigation, native
  FormData values, viewport-aware placement and reduced-motion support.
- Add eight optimized Almond interior photographs as staggered editorial spreads
  with RevealFrame entrances and inner-image drift. Put descriptive bottom-left
  Josefin Sans footnotes inside project scene photographs and all About photographs.
  Keep project heroes free of status eyebrows and exterior footnotes. Remove the
  visible PDF helper text and Pricing available on inquiry note.
- Arrange the About process as Build, Draw, Hand over. Cap the first left portrait
  at 75svh height, with slower text right. Use a small faster Draw image right and
  text left, then a medium central Hand over photo with an overlapping blended
  heading and readable body text right. Stack the layout and remove outer parallax
  on smaller screens.
- Remove the homepage About eyebrow on desktop and mobile.
- Make the Projects hub hero one viewport tall, with its first portrait centered
  on both axes and further portraits extending to the right beyond the viewport.
  Set the title bottom-left and introduction bottom-right with page-grid padding.
  Remove the hero counts and keep the two project ledgers below.
- Open gallery and editorial photographs in a shared dark lightbox. Keep linked
  project images as project-page navigation. Desktop arrows use rectangles outside
  the image; mobile and touch arrows sit inside with transparent backgrounds.
  Use uncropped photographs, swipe and keyboard navigation, restored scroll/focus,
  reduced motion and a preview fallback on image-loading errors.
- Keep hero text hidden until its font-dependent masks are prepared, with visible
  reduced-motion and no-JavaScript fallbacks. Initialize cached fonts immediately.
  Prepare below-fold About, Projects and footer text near the viewport. Prefetch
  primary routes and project pages without changing the accepted expansion motion.
